articles.title: Wynn Supports "Walk for a Million" with MOP 700,000 Donation
articles.summary: Wynn donated MOP 700,000 to the Charity Fund from the Readers of Macao Daily News for Walk for a Million, and more than 1,000 team members and their families will join the 13 December walk. A cheque presentation was held on 24 November at Wynn Palace as Wynn marks 20 years in Macao.

articles.title: Sands China Hosts Community Events to Support 73rd Macau Grand Prix
articles.rawDate: Nov.22 Sands China Hosts Community Events to Support 73rd Macau Grand Prix
articles.summary: Sands China was a major sponsor of the 73rd Macau Grand Prix (19–22 November) and, through Sands Cares, hosted community activities for local social-service families, including a Grand Prix Museum visit and a Guia Circuit race day. The programme supports Macao’s integrated ‘tourism + sport’ development and its positioning as a City of Sports.

articles.title: SJM Donates MOP700,000 to Support the 43rd Walk for a Million
articles.summary: SJM Resorts donated MOP 700,000 to the Charity Fund from the Readers of Macao Daily News for the 43rd Walk for a Million, including proceeds from the Macau satellite of the 2026 World Alba White Truffle Charity Auction. The company will field a team of 3,000 staff, families and friends for the 13 December walk, with a cheque presentation at Grand Lisboa Macau.

articles.title: MGM Wins Gold and Silver at CIHAPB Community Intelligent Housing Award (Greater Bay Area) 2026
articles.summary: MGM COTAI and MGM MACAU won Gold and Silver respectively in the Hospitality Category of the CIHAPB Community Intelligent Housing Award (Greater Bay Area) 2026, organised by the Chartered Institute of Housing Asian Pacific Branch. MGM was the only one of Macau’s six integrated resort operators to receive an award.

articles.title: Sands China’s Community Revitalization Programme Unveils ‘The Hall of Glory – Iec Long Firecracker Factory’
articles.rawDate: Nov.17 Sands China’s Community Revitalization Programme Unveils ‘The Hall of Glory – Iec Long Firecracker Factory’
articles.summary: Sands China unveiled The Hall of Glory at the former Iec Long Firecracker Factory, a permanent community-tourism attraction developed with new-media artists Professors Jeffrey Shaw and Sarah Kenderdine. The project preserves Macao’s century-old firecracker heritage on its original site through research, conservation and immersive technology.
